24: The accepted Agent Core `AGENT_CORE_FLEET_SHARED_CODEX_AUTH_V3` at
25: `0386b34a3d1054c71cbe51a2310fdff4d55c992b` requires separate accepted plugin
26: authority (§3 L208–219). Its CTR-SCA-001–010 still require canonical identity,
27: cross-process locking, durable intent, fail-closed unknown outcome and explicit
28: Owner reauth. These obligations are carried forward, not declared obsolete.
29: 
30: The actual 0.2.3 release has SHA-256
31: `869b8e64095a796a0fe6cfbe7bc09e5cf49dfa35defba7b69d621cfec0d0290f`;
32: its store/service/index source exactly matches donor revision above.
33: The rejected native 0.2.5 release has SHA-256
34: `cf22a2f0d64037fa3f710f3f590f595ef8e200bad06f3fc0028e71e54b80b4f3`.
35: The complete investigation is `/tmp/025-compat-report/REPORT.md`.
36: 
37: Current remote main is 0.3.2, not 0.2.5. Its credentialFile transport is present,
38: but shared updates use process-local serialization, have no durable intent, and
39: do not enforce every path component or private-parent boundary. New document
40: formats and provider-conflict checks do not substitute for the V3 protocol.

60: 
61: Decisions: one canonical filename/lock/intent authority remains required;
62: none of the three protection groups is obsolete; preserve main's established
63: document and front-door behavior while restoring the missing protocol; use a
64: separate native-0.2.5 branch for the r2 artifact. These are bounded decisions
65: for this plugin derivative, not amendments of Core's production contracts.

67: ### R1 — Canonical configuration, identity and permissions
68: 
69: Retain or restore optional credentialFile in Config/schema/apply/service/store.
70: Outside explicitly configured shared mode, preserve the DSH_HOME default.
71: Inside shared mode require an absolute path, no symlink in any component,
72: single-link regular credential/intent files, private parent directory and
73: owner-only modes. Never fallback to a per-home store. Keep credentialFile out
74: of volatile preference/settings descriptors. Test the real Loader/apply chain.
75: 
76: ### R2 — Refresh intent and cross-process coordination
77: 
78: Port donor canonical-filename writer locking, lock-internal reread and pending
79: inspection. Before a refresh callback can dispatch, durably publish the exact
80: V3 pending intent (version, non-secret device/inode generationId, pending state,
81: RFC3339 startedAt), fsync file and parent directory. Atomic credential commit
82: must be followed by file/parent durability, then durable intent removal.
83: Existing pending intent cannot be overwritten by automatic refresh. Waiters
84: must reread or wait without another provider call; bounded exhaustion exposes
85: the stable OPENAI_CODEX_REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS discriminant.
86: 
87: For main preserve decodeCredentialDocument/update, idToken/email and unrelated
88: provider fields, concurrent-edit detection, proxy arguments, policy/settings
89: and usage-cache behavior. Process-local serialization alone is insufficient.
90: Do not overwrite donor files wholesale over main.
91: 
92: ### R3 — Unknown outcome, error identity and explicit Owner recovery
93: 
94: Same-generation pending intent fails closed before read/use/refresh, forbids
95: old-token reuse and surfaces stable redacted OPENAI_CODEX_REAUTH_REQUIRED.
96: Replacement-generation recovery validates credential document and permissions
97: before controlled intent clearing, with no refresh. Invalid replacement keeps
98: evidence. Lock age alone never permits orphan deletion.
99: 
100: Port donor explicit Owner reauth scope around authorized interactive login;
101: automatic refresh cannot enter that scope. Audit actual service/Web/CLI login
102: call paths: donor service-only coverage must not be represented as universal
103: front-door recovery. Add scope to the common explicit login seam if required,
104: with direct tests, and preserve cancellation/proxy/cache behavior.
105: 
106: Retain donor public error exports. Resolve the newer usage.ts class name
107: collision so store, usage predicate and root exports recognize the same
108: reauth condition without deleting existing HTTP 401/403 behavior. Test actual

157: 
158: Rejected alternatives: automatic retry after unknown rotation, per-home writable
159: fallback/copies/link/sync, treating process-local serialization as a cross-process
160: lock, and relabelling all 0.3.2 main features as a pure 0.2.5-r2 restoration.
161: Migration/rollback: this task installs nothing and retains all original artifacts;
162: no credential/session migration or runtime rollback is authorized. Any future
163: adoption must separately establish reader/rollback compatibility and Owner apply.
164: 
165: Completion of these checks means a local restoration candidate was delivered.
166: It does not amend Agent Core V3's 0.2.3 compatibility pin, establish full V3
167: compatibility, production admission, rollout permission or runtime acceptance.
168: 
169: 
170: ## Acceptance transaction (2026-10-31)
171: 
172: Accepted by supervisor under Owner retained authorities (semantic/identity class) after non-author review (30/30 static identity checks, INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md). Basis: the three protection groups (canonical config passthrough, refresh-intent, unknown-outcome fail-closed) are REQUIRED — V3 CTR-SCA-001-010 obligations carried forward; donor revision 75d98d5b is the production-proven 0.2.3 lineage. Implementation proceeds per IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md (0.3.2 main fix + 0.2.5-r2 backport), zero production writes until rollout admission.
